main_text.p: quisse dicetur, si magistrum ut privatum, vim inferentem re-Necess. defensc. 6. n 33. pellat; etiam cum aliter peri-Tulden. tit. Cod. culum evitare non posset, oc-Quand. liceat cidat.

Idque probatur de jurecuique sine jud. ci-vili. 1. Quia vim vi repelle-re, lex indistincte permittit.Mynsing. cent.5. Obs.18. Et cum lex loquatur genera-l.3.D de Just. & jur. l.5. Cod.de jur. fisc. libr.10. l.1.§.cum arietes.liter, neque distinguat inter personam publicam, & privatam, nostrum non erit distin-ctionem non allegatam in lege,allegare. Erubescimus enim sine lege loqui. 2. Quia vim atque injuriam propulsareD.si quadr. l.31. D.de Re-gul.jur. ju-ris est naturae. Ut cuivis id li-ceat adversus quemvis. Ratio rationis est, quia quae juris sunt naturalis, immutari non possunt, neque quod attinet jus naturale, ratione conditionis aut dignitatis hominis ulla est distinctio. Ut quicunque in jus naturae impingit, effectum juris naturae experiri

page.notes: Margin notes are grouped where a block of notes stands beside several lines: the "l.3.D de Just." group is placed at its first line. Reading of "Necess." (printed Neceff.) and "Re-gul" is taken from a small type and may be imperfect. "funt" and "fine" read as sunt and sine (long s). "Ratio." is printed with a stop after it. Printed "ge,allegare" has no space after the comma, as printed.
